Implement JSON Merge Patch (RFC 7386)

Add applyMergePatch(target, patch), which merges an object patch into an
object target member by member, removes the members a patch sets to null,
and lets any other patch replace the target outright. The merge builds a
fresh document, so neither the target nor the patch is touched and the
result shares nothing with them.

As for the "value" of a JSON Patch operation, a patch that is not a JSON
value all the way down is rejected with a JsonMergePatchError rather than
written into the document; applying a well-formed merge patch cannot fail.
